newsitem.title: USA: Atlas Air renews China Air, Varig contracts.
newsitem.headline: Atlas Air renews China Air, Varig contracts.

text.p: Atlas Air Inc said Wednesday it had renewed contracts with Taiwan's China Airlines and the Brazilian airline Varig and had entered into a contract with China Airlines for an additional aircraft.
Atlas Air said the value of the contracts totalled some $240 million.
Atlas Air said China Airlines had entered into a five-year aircraft, crew, maintenance and insurance contract, replacing a three-year pact scheduled to expire in January 1997.
It said China Airlines had also signed a five-year contract for an additional aircraft to enter service in 1997.
Atlas also said it was in talks with KLM Royal Dutch Airlines NV regarding one of two aircraft operated by Atlas for KLM.
It said it was in talks with Swissair Schweizerische Luftverkehr AG regarding the possible renewal of existing contracts scheduled to terminate at year-end.
Atlas provides both freigher aircraft and crews to major airlines. Its stock was up two points to 38-1/2 in morning trading.
